_comment: Phase 3E1 golden Read-Along scoring cases. Shared by tests/learning_stt_test.py (backend port)
and tests/learning_stt_parity.test.js, which derives the same numbers from the LIVE pronWords/
showPron rule extracted out of index.html. Small synthetic + real sentences, no audio.

cases.name: perfect read
cases.target: Hi, Anna. Look! We are at the zoo.
cases.transcript: hi anna look we are at the zoo

cases.name: case and punctuation are ignored
cases.target: The panda is black and white.
cases.transcript: THE PANDA IS BLACK AND WHITE!!!

cases.name: extra filler words do not hurt
cases.target: The panda is black and white.
cases.transcript: um the panda is black and white you know

cases.name: missing words lower the score
cases.target: The panda is black and white.

cases.name: word order is irrelevant
cases.target: The panda is black and white.
cases.transcript: white and black is panda the

cases.name: half a contraction does not score its token
negative contraction
cases.target: No, I didn't, because it was too high.
cases.transcript: no i did not because it was too high

cases.name: rounding half-up: 1 of 8
cases.target: a b c d e f g h

cases.name: rounding half-up: 5 of 8
cases.target: a b c d e f g h

cases.name: non-English content pack still scores by the same rule
